user_requirement: Every direction and path-following maneuver must reach the smoothness of the liked forward walk; zero command must settle into a quiet static stance.
evidence_required: Existing static and transition tracking/stability/motor gates pass on matched checkpoint and source
Same-speed same-view actual-simulation video review across required cases
Per-case joint motion and target changes, body velocity/yaw variation, drift, contact slip and requested/applied torque
Quiet stance after settling; distinguish intended response to a disturbance from spontaneous chatter
Held-out seeds and robustness checks within the declared operating envelope
quantitative_smoothness_thresholds: Calibrate from matched reference traces and validated standing controls; do not invent a pass by relaxing motor or failure limits.
